findings.description: This policy grants the deploy user ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:* and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*", i.e. full control of compute, every S3 object/bucket in the account, and all Lambda functions. Wildcard actions over wildcard resources violate least privilege and give a single static identity the ability to read/modify/destroy the account's data and workloads.

Creates a permanent, non-expiring IAM access key for the svc-deploy user. Static long-lived keys cannot be scoped by session and remain valid until manually rotated, so any leak of the secret persists indefinitely; short-lived STS/role credentials would limit this exposure.

The access key secret material is emitted as a Terraform output without sensitive = true, so it is rendered to CLI/plan output and retained in state, exposing deploy credentials to anyone with read access to the state backend or build logs.
